model: recursive 27-child yoyo, dual counterrotation, rigid hub, two recursive generations, composed local frames about common z axis
control: signed winding count separate from monotonic absolute tick; -1 unwind, +1 wind, 0 rest

checks.name: each non-root has an existing parent
all sampled siblings disjoint and children contained
every hub remains at parent center

analytical: Within a lobe all siblings undergo the same rigid rotation; opposite lobes have fixed axial separation 4r; each hub-to-lobe distance and center norm are invariant. Containment plus sibling disjointness recursively implies disjoint descendants belonging to distinct sibling branches.
limits: All cubit positions computed as normalized geometry, with common-axis orientation chosen for this pass; no physical time or Planck-scale simulation.
Sampled collision checks supplemented by rigid-lobe geometric argument; exact facet contact not asserted.
Visualization uses bounding spheres for 2187-leaf overview; inherits mesh definition from previous implementation. Browser rendering untested.
No action, witness, governance, or consensus layer.
